contents.name: Compact-space Laplace principle and exponential tilting

source_review.read_extent: Read Section III.E.4, equations (59)–(60), and the nearby qualification at printed pp. 19–20.
source_review.supports: The exponential-integral variational formula for continuous tilts of an LDP.
source_review.limitations: The review gives the theorem and interpretation but not a complete compact-space finite-cover proof; the authored item supplies that proof and its normalized-tilt LDP.

contents.name: Finite-alphabet reference laws, mean-field canonical variational form, and constrained entropy

source_review.read_extent: Read Section IV.B on empirical vectors and Sanov rates; Sections V.B–V.D on reference-law entropy, energy constraints, and canonical Gibbs weights; Section V.E on ensemble equivalence, printed pp. 26–27 and 39–54.
source_review.supports: The relative-entropy variational structure and the distinction between constrained microcanonical entropy and canonical minimization.
source_review.limitations: The treatment uses thermodynamic-limit notation and some heuristic/Laplace discussion. The item is proved locally for a finite alphabet using the exact imported Sanov theorem and the compact Laplace theorem; its shrinking-shell limit states the required matching conditions.

source_review.read_extent: Read the canonical variational discussion in Section V.D and the phase-transition/nonequivalence qualifications in Section V.E, printed pp. 48–54.
source_review.supports: The interpretation of global minimizers as canonical equilibrium macrostates and the warning that stationary points alone do not establish equilibrium.
source_review.limitations: The source is not used as the local global-minimizer proof; the item proves the full derivative-sign and endpoint classification.

source_review.read_extent: Read Section V.E, printed pp. 52–54, including its statement that nonconcave entropy is not recovered by canonical Legendre-Fenchel inversion and that only supported energies are canonically realized.
source_review.supports: The supporting-line criterion and the distinction between canonical access and the full microcanonical entropy curve.
source_review.limitations: The specific binary energy h(q)=q_1^{1/4} and its strict-convexity calculation are constructed and proved locally.

source_review.read_extent: Read Sections IV.B and V.B–V.D, printed pp. 26–27 and 39–50, for empirical macrostates, full-support reference laws, canonical weights and constrained energy windows.
source_review.supports: The mathematical conventions motivating the finite empirical-measure and product-reference model.
source_review.limitations: The definition fixes the finite-alphabet state spaces and conventions explicitly; no general interacting or spatial model is imported.
